related.title: 飛輪儲能磁軸承系統
related.titleEn: Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「功率、能量與時長」與「最大輸出功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；飛輪儲能磁軸承系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power, energy and duration" and "Peak output power" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦幾秒鐘的儲能：電容儲能、可用電壓範圍、串聯不均、被動均衡、最大功率與時間常數；飛輪儲能磁軸承系統則以懸浮在真空裡的高速轉子：動能、可用轉速範圍、輪緣應力、磁浮承載、待機損失與爆裂能量為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on storage for seconds: capacitor energy, usable voltage range, series imbalance, passive balancing, peak power and time constant; Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems centres on A fast rotor levitated in vacuum: kinetic energy, usable speed range, rim stress, magnetic lift, standby loss and burst energy, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「儲存的能量」與「飛輪動能」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「串聯後的電容與電壓」的模型移到飛輪儲能磁軸承系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「待機損失的時間常數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored" and "Flywheel kinetic energy".
Move the model of "Capacitance and voltage in series" to Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time constant of standby loss", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「功率、能量與時長」與「最大輸出功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；飛輪儲能磁軸承系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power, energy and duration" and "Peak output power" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Flywheel Energy Storage Magnetic Bearing Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 電網儲能電池管理系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「功率、能量與時長」與「最大輸出功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power, energy and duration" and "Peak output power" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦幾秒鐘的儲能：電容儲能、可用電壓範圍、串聯不均、被動均衡、最大功率與時間常數；電網儲能電池管理系統則以看管五十萬顆電芯的系統：電壓精度與荷電狀態、均衡時間、資料量、過充保護與監控空窗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on storage for seconds: capacitor energy, usable voltage range, series imbalance, passive balancing, peak power and time constant; Grid Storage Battery Management Systems centres on the system watching half a million cells: voltage accuracy and state of charge, balancing time, data volume, overcharge protection and monitoring gaps, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「儲存的能量」與「功率、能量與時長」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「串聯後的電容與電壓」的模型移到電網儲能電池管理系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「過充保護的時間餘裕」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored" and "Power, energy and duration".
Move the model of "Capacitance and voltage in series" to Grid Storage Battery Management Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time margin for overcharge protection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「功率、能量與時長」與「最大輸出功率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；電網儲能電池管理系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power, energy and duration" and "Peak output power" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grid Storage Battery Management Systems must be respecified.

history.title: 超級電容模組均衡設計
history.text: 1957 年雙電層電容的專利被提出；1978 年超級電容開始商品化；2009 年曲面石墨烯電極的開發公司成立。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1957: A patent for the double-layer capacitor was filed. 1978: Supercapacitors were first commercialised. 2009: A developer of curved graphene electrodes was founded. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
